findings.message: The shared ScriptFS stores files only in memory while the serve-admission fixture’s Git operations use the real checkout. The required config save and merge-file operations therefore fail for tracked local config edits, causing integration tests that pass on the base commit to fail on the candidate. This fixture is outside the scope fence.
findings.paved_road: Expand the scope fence to include the shared fixture and update it so its filesystem seam and Git operations observe the same checkout and temporary files.
